items.text: Round 2 decisions (d1–d4) all resolved to the recommended option A. Folded into Contract Decisions as locked contracts: re-defer updates revisit_after in place with [re-deferred] note; decision-list shows deferred by default with --status=deferred filter; 365-day horizon cap enforced at API via MaxRevisitAfterDays const; response shape uses omitempty for revisit_after on non-deferred rows. Removed 'pending workshop round 2' subsection and the forward-looking language from the risk matrix.

Plan now fully specifies all transition rules: pending→deferred (fresh), deferred→deferred (re-defer in place), deferred→pending (auto/manual), deferred→accepted, deferred→rejected. deferred→running and deferred→completed remain disallowed. Added explicit test cases for re-defer-in-place and horizon-cap enforcement. Added MaxRevisitAfterDays=365 const requirement to Phase 1 data model work.

CLI decision-list default visibility behavior added to Phase 3 (step 5) and Definition of Done. Deferred rows appear in default list output with their status column — consistent with how accepted/rejected behave today.

Initiative-context check (prompt-manager-decision-workflow-polish, 6 members, 0 upstream/downstream): only fix/prompt-manager-decision-show-options-default-output materially overlaps (CLI human output for decision-show). Either ordering works; the coordination note is captured in Cross-Initiative Implications and in the risk matrix. No orchestrator action required.

Readiness raised to 3/3 across all dimensions. Plan is implementation-ready: concrete file paths + line numbers, full transition matrix, explicit test list, locked contract decisions, no open questions.

plan_updates: Folded round 2 answers (d1=A re-defer in place; d2=A decision-list includes deferred by default with --status filter; d3=A 365-day horizon cap; d4=A omitempty on non-deferred rows) into locked Contract Decisions. Removed the 'Validation Rules (pending workshop round 2)' subsection. Added MaxRevisitAfterDays=365 const to Phase 1. Added deferred→deferred (re-defer in place) to the allowed transition matrix. Added CLI decision-list default-visibility behavior to Phase 3 and two new CLI tests (TestCmdDecisionListIncludesDeferredByDefault, TestCmdDecisionListStatusDeferredFilter). Added two new API tests (TestUpdateDecision_DeferRejectsHorizonExceeded, TestUpdateDecision_ReDeferInPlace). Tightened risk matrix: typo'd far-future date risk now cites the concrete 365-day cap and MaxRevisitAfterDays const; re-defer ambiguity risk now points to the locked contract and test. Updated Rollout checklist and Definition of Done to reflect re-defer-in-place, horizon cap, MaxRevisitAfterDays const, and decision-list default visibility. Updated Cross-Initiative Implications to note that either ordering with decision-show-options-default-output works. Added 'No duration-based CLI sugar' to Non-goals to reflect the d2 (round 1) option C rejection.
